newsitem.title: USA: Gelman targets FY97 SG&A ratio of 34 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gelman targets FY97 SG&A ratio of 34 pct.

text.p: Gelman Sciences Inc said it plans to reduce sales, general and administrative (SG&A) expenses to 34 percent of sales in fiscal 1997.
That ratio reached 39 percent in the fourth quarter, up from 35.8 percent in the year-ago period, Gelman said.

The fourth-quarter increase was due "almost entirely to lower sales," said chief operating officer Kim Davis in a conference call following Gelman's release of fiscal fourth-quarter financial results.
Shares in the Ann Arbor, Michigan-based microfiltration and medial products maker were off 3/8 to 26-1/2.
"We anticipate a reduction in our FY97 SG&A, measured as a percentage of sales. And I will share with you that our fiscal '97 plan contemplates SG&A at approximately 34 percent of sales," Davis said.

The company reported a loss of $0.25 per share in the fourth quarter, compared to a year-ago profit of $0.27 per share. Sales in the period ended July 31 were $28.1 million, versus $28.4 million a year earlier.
"We feel many of the issues in the fourth quarter are of a one-time nature.... The bad news is behind us," Davis said.
